items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: The only real teacher I ever had was Lawrence Marrero.

ctx.x: Did you have any lessons when you started?
No, I, well, to a certain degree. The only real teacher I ever had was Lawrence Marrero.
And what did he teach you?
